prompts.atlas: Edit target: image 1 is the sixteen-frame transparent basketball animation atlas. Reference image 2 is the canonical face identity. Preserve all 16 poses, green/ivory uniform, brown-skinned slender adult, enormous moustache, heavy eyebrows, full black fringe and swept-up side hair. Improve the game-ready atlas: remove EVERY red, yellow, white and gray halo, stray pixel cloud and background fragment around the figures. Background must be clean true transparent alpha with no matte, no shadows and no colored glow. Increase crisp material/face detail and likeness to reference 2. Re-layout precisely into a 4x4 equal-cell grid. In EACH cell full figure must have generous 10% transparent margin on ALL sides including raised hands, hair and feet. Fix the SHOOT raised-hands frames so fingers are entirely INSIDE their bottom-row cells, never crossing the row boundary. Keep one consistent character scale and feet baseline per cell; neutral figures in column one identical. No ball, no hoop, no extra objects, no letters, no borders. Hand-painted realistic premium sports-game asset, not flat vector or children's cartoon. Preserve pose sequence row1 empty-hand dribble, row2 between legs, row3 behind back, row4 shoot, each with ready/anticipation/action/follow-through. Return maximum quality portrait transparent PNG atlas.
prompts.arena: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original premium iPhone basketball game BACKGROUND ONLY, portrait 2:3 composition. A richly art-directed vintage American indoor fieldhouse at night, warmly lit honey-colored hardwood basketball floor in strong perspective, court boundary lines and central circle, deep forest-green lower walls, softly out-of-focus packed spectator bleachers, steel rafters, atmospheric amber overhead spotlights with a cool teal fill. Cinematic hand-painted realism with tactile wood and subtle film grain, polished sports game environment, not a flat vector diagram and not cartoon clipart. Camera centered court-level, natural perspective, empty center foreground reserved for a full-body basketball character to be composited later. IMPORTANT layout: background dark and quiet in upper 25% for command UI, stands/horizon at 43% image height, brightly but softly lit unobstructed floor from 43% down to bottom. Center character standing position around 62% image height must be ON THE WOOD FLOOR. Crowd and architecture should frame the center, not compete with gameplay. Side lights create a subtle central pool of warm light and depth. No player, no people in foreground, no basketball anywhere, no hoop or backboard visible, no logos, no signage, no text, no HUD. Precise original environment for Shadow Basketballing, matching forest-green/ivory uniform and brown skin warm key light from upper left. High resolution portrait image.
